Confirmed directly from the pinned LMDB source in the corpus (`/root/.xerj-code/corpora/lmdb/lmdb/libraries/liblmdb/mdb.c`):

- **`mdb.c:791`** — `#define DEFAULT_MAPSIZE	1048576`, with the preceding comment: *"Default size of memory map. This is certainly too small for any actual applications. Apps should always set the size explicitly using mdb_env_set_mapsize()."*
- **`mdb.c:5547`** — when a brand-new environment is created (no existing metapage), `meta.mm_mapsize = DEFAULT_MAPSIZE;` — i.e. the value is used in raw bytes, not multiplied by page size. (`mdb.c:5562` also uses the sentinel comparison `env->me_mapsize == DEFAULT_MAPSIZE` for MDB_RAWPART.)

ANSWER: 1048576 bytes (1 MiB) — `DEFAULT_MAPSIZE` in `libraries/liblmdb/mdb.c:791`
